summary: The candidate adds only regression tests and reports over a base that already contains production draft-pool accounting. Its suite passes, but both new assertions undercount actual unified draft capacity by using full_tokens rather than the allocator's virtual-span-derived, page-padded draft token count. The candidate is incomplete test-only hardening, and the original 8x B300 Inkling startup path remains unverified in this ROCm single-GPU environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate exact commit: 43 pool-configurator tests and 7 subtests passed.
Both candidate regressions pass at the exact reviewed commit; source inspection shows their independent footprint formulas omit unified draft virtual-span and page-padding bytes.

sglang imported from /job/repo/python/sglang; Torch imported from the prepared ROCm installation; one AMD Instinct MI355X executed FP32 matmul with max absolute error 7.62939453125e-06 against a CPU FP64-derived reference.

remaining_counterexamples: A hybrid full/SWA case where draft pools use ceil_align(target virtual span, page_size) plus one page is not independently measured by either new assertion; both charge draft layers for full_tokens only.
The exact 8x NVIDIA B300, CUDA 13, TP8, Inkling-NVFP4, eight-draft-pool startup sequence remains unexecuted and could still expose integration or architecture-specific allocation behavior.
The issue's MXFP8 scale-byte geometry is not exercised by the candidate's Inkling-style test.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2 was available; no NVIDIA B300 or CUDA environment was available.
Inkling-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so no full server, FP4/MXFP8, TP8, or eight-GPU reproduction was possible.
No native source changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json declares no prepared native artifact, and no native rebuild was applicable.
The original reported failure was not reproduced end to end on the prepared base; the base source already contains related production accounting.
